notes: The crew chat now works like Messenger: reply, edit, delete, react, see who has seen your message, and send a quick 📿.
new: Press and hold a message (or right-click) to react with 📿 ❤️ 👏 👍, reply, copy, edit or delete it.
Swipe a message sideways to reply to it.
Seen by: small profile pictures under your message show who has read it.
Tap the 📿 button next to the message box to send it quickly. It turns into the send arrow when you type.
Messages with only emoji show big, and messages you send appear instantly.
changed: Messages are grouped into rounded bubbles like Messenger.
Run patch7.sql once in Supabase to turn on edit, reply, reactions and seen.
